title: The True House | 2 miles to Downtown |Rooftop Deck
description:
This house is on a very quiet street in the up and coming neighborhood,  the Buchanan Arts District of Nashville (North Nashville). It is only 1 mile to Germantown, 3 miles to East Nashville and 2 miles to downtown Nashville. Only a 5 minute uber/lyft to downtown and trendy restaurants such as 5th and Taylor, Rolf and Daughter, City House , Silo , Butchertown Hall and walking distance to the hottest local  pizza joint, Slim and Husky's Pizza Beeria.

The space
Inside The Property 
      This house has a fully stocked kitchen and a cozy living room with smart TV . Updated kitchen with new appliances including a full-size fridge, dishwasher, stove, microwave, Keurig coffee maker and washer/dryer. Tea and coffee included!

     Master bedroom has a queen size bed and own bathroom. The other two bedrooms have full size beds and a shared bathroom. Hangers, iron, ironing board, hair dryer, shampoo, body wash, and towels are provided. 

Outside The Property 
      Easily accessible  street parking in front. Huge rooftop deck with dining table.
      Guests will be given a keypad code for easy, keyless check in/check out.

The house is very centrally located and easy to get around with cheap Uber/Lyft

2.0 miles to Musicians Hall of Frame and Museum
2.1 miles to Tennessee Performing Arts Center 
2.1 miles to Nashville Sounds Stadium
2.5 miles to Bridgestone Arena
2.8 miles to Nissan Stadium

2 miles to The Gulch

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire home, rooftop deck, high-speed Wi-Fi, smart TV . Updated kitchen with new appliances including a full-size fridge, dishwasher, stove, microwave and washer/dryer.

There are outdoor cameras outside the house for security
